segments.name: Oncosalud Peru
segments.description: Provides prepaid healthcare plans and oncology services to plan members and patients at its own facilities in Peru.
segments.evidence: Our Oncosalud Peru segment consists of our prepaid healthcare plans and oncology services provided at our Oncosalud Peru segment facilities, including services provided under our prepaid plans and third-party healthcare plans and paid for out-of-pocket by our patients.

segments.name: Healthcare Services in Peru
segments.description: Delivers hospital and clinic healthcare services to patients and third-party payers at its facilities in Peru outside Oncosalud.
segments.evidence: Our Healthcare Services in Peru segment consists of healthcare services provided at any of our facilities in Peru other than those in the Oncosalud network.

segments.name: Healthcare Services in Colombia
segments.description: Provides healthcare services to patients at its hospital and clinic facilities in Colombia.
segments.evidence: Our Healthcare Services in Colombia segment consists of healthcare services provided at any of our facilities in Colombia.

segments.name: Healthcare Services in Mexico
segments.description: Provides hospital healthcare services, dental and vision insurance plans, and oncology plans to patients and members in Mexico.
segments.evidence: Our Healthcare Services in Mexico segment consists of healthcare services provided at any of our facilities in Mexico and dental, vision insurance plans and oncology plans.

revenueModel.text: Plan members, patients and third-party payers pay for prepaid healthcare plans and healthcare services at the company's hospitals and clinics.
revenueModel.evidence: We operate hospitals and clinics in Mexico, Peru and Colombia and provide prepaid healthcare plans in Peru and Mexico.
